deviation: The draft drops the 90-day correction/re-performance remedy and states there is no express warranty period (7.3), and adds a blanket disclaimer of all implied warranties (7.4). Arcadia would lose its free re-performance right and conformance to the SOW, which is worse than the 60-day fallback and conflicts with the playbook's "no blanket disclaimers" position.
suggested_text:
7.1 Services Warranty. Ironbridge warrants that the Services will be performed with reasonable skill and care, by suitably qualified personnel, in accordance with applicable law, and will conform to the applicable Statement of Work. Ironbridge shall correct any non-conforming Services free of charge for 90 days after acceptance.

7.2 Mutual Warranties. Each Party warrants that it has full authority to enter into and perform this Agreement and that doing so does not breach any other agreement binding on it.

[Delete 7.3 and 7.4. These warranties are in addition to, and do not limit, any warranties or conditions implied by law or any other rights or remedies of Arcadia.]
